mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.news_id, c.target_type, c.user_id, c.content, c.create_time, u.real_name AS user_name, u.role AS user_role, u.avatar AS user_avatar, CASE c.target_type WHEN 'news' THEN n.title WHEN 'video' THEN v.title WHEN 'topic' THEN t.title END AS target_title, c.target_type AS target_type_info FROM comment c LEFT JOIN `user` u ON c.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN news n ON c.target_type = 'news' AND c.news_id = n.id LEFT JOIN video v ON c.target_type = 'video' AND c.news_id = v.id LEFT JOIN topic t ON c.target_type = 'topic' AND c.news_id = t.id WHERE c.news_id = #{targetId} AND c.target_type = #{targetType} ORDER BY c.create_time DESC, c.id DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comment WHERE news_id = #{targetId} AND target_type = #{targetType}

SELECT c.id, c.news_id, c.target_type, c.user_id, c.content, c.create_time, u.real_name AS user_name, u.role AS user_role, u.avatar AS user_avatar, CASE c.target_type WHEN 'news' THEN n.title WHEN 'video' THEN v.title WHEN 'topic' THEN t.title END AS target_title, c.target_type AS target_type_info FROM comment c LEFT JOIN `user` u ON c.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN news n ON c.target_type = 'news' AND c.news_id = n.id LEFT JOIN video v ON c.target_type = 'video' AND c.news_id = v.id LEFT JOIN topic t ON c.target_type = 'topic' AND c.news_id = t.id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY c.create_time DESC, c.id DESC
